title: MdmServer.Attributes
description:
Attributes that describe a device management service resource.

Apple Business API 2.6+

> **Note:** You can add new attributes to a resource without a newer version of an API.

createdDateTime.description: The date and time of the creation of the resource.

defaultProductFamilies.description: The product families that are assigned by default to this device management service. Read/update only.

deviceCount.description: The number of devices currently assigned to this device management service. Read only.

enableMdmDisownFlag.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the device management service is allowed to disown its enrolled devices.

lastConnectedDateTime.description: The date and time the device management service last connected to Apple’s servers. Read only.

lastConnectedIp.description: The IP address from which the device management service last connected to Apple’s servers. Read only.

serverType.description: The type of device management service: `MDM`, `APPLE_CONFIGURATOR`, `APPLE_MDM`. Read only.

status.description: The operational status of the device management service. Read only. See [MdmServerStatus](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/applebusinessapi/mdmserverstatus) for possible values.

updatedDateTime.description: The date and time of the most-recent update for the resource.
